title: Lamina PDF form data
description: A form's answers by field name, as fill_form and fillForm take them and export_form_data and exportFormData write them as JSON.

$schema.description: This schema's address. Ignored when read.

fields.description: Each field's value by its fully qualified name: each parent's name, then the field's, joined by a full stop (customer.name).

oneOf.description: A text field's text, a button's on-state name or export value, or a list's one export value. A number is taken as its text.
A check box with one on-state: true is on, false is off.
A list box's selected export values, several when it allows them.
Empty: no value, or a button turned off.
